title: Elderly Man and Robot Companion
description: An elderly man in a green coat and hat walks with a cane along a cracked path, carrying a small blue robot on his back. The surreal landscape features a red mountain range, floating geometric triangles, a crystal ball, and a dark chasm filled with triangular patterns under a stippled sky.
prompt: An elderly man wearing a green coat and fedora walks with a cane along a cracked winding path, a small blue robot with glowing eyes riding on his back. Surreal landscape with red mountains, floating triangular shapes, a glowing crystal ball, purple flowers, and a dark abyss containing geometric triangular patterns. Stippled sky, line art details, surreal and melancholic atmosphere.
